title: Brandon:
headline: Reading got Brandon out of a hard childhood. Now his voice helps pick a national book prize.
story: Brandon grew up in a hard place. Reading was his escape. As he got older, books became a positive outlet and a way to teach himself.

Now he is a judge for the Inside Literary Prize. He says it shows him that he still has a voice, and that voice matters. This is a story about dignity and growth. It must feel calm and hopeful. Never a sad prison story.
